name: Can I build luxury townhomes on a narrow lot?

mainEntity.name: Can a narrow lot in Los Angeles still support luxury townhome construction?
mainEntity.text: Can a narrow lot in Los Angeles still support luxury townhome construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: A narrow lot can absolutely support a luxury townhome project, but the design must be exceptionally efficient. Narrow sites make it harder to fit parking, stairs, storage, and proper daylight without creating awkward floor plans. The best projects solve this with simple structural planning, well-placed windows, and layouts that protect privacy and natural light. Luxury does not have to mean oversized; it usually means better proportions, better material quality, and smarter space planning. On narrow lots, the project can still feel premium if the entry sequence, ceiling heights, finish package, and outdoor connections are handled well. The most common mistake is trying to force a large, ornate design onto a site that really wants a compact and elegant massing strategy. A narrow lot is not a deal-breaker, but it requires design discipline from the start.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a narrow lot can still work if the plan uses efficient circulation, stacked layouts, smart window placement, and a clean structural grid. The main challenge is fitting parking, stairs, light, and code-required clearances without making the units feel cramped.
